recent_posts.title: fylepad — an open source aesthetic notepad of your dreams
recent_posts.summary: fylepad is an open-source, offline-first notepad application that has grown to 262 GitHub stars. Version 3.0.0 introduces Notion-style slash commands, a command palette, and polished visuals. The app supports Markdown formatting with Mermaid and PlantUML diagrams, local-only storage, multi-tab editing, and PDF/Markdown export. Built with a Rust core for performance and security, it runs cross-platform on Linux, Windows, Mac, and web browsers without requiring cloud connectivity.

recent_posts.title: WebGL shaders with Three.js in Nuxt
recent_posts.summary: WebGL and Three.js enable GPU-accelerated graphics and shader programming within Nuxt projects to create dynamic visual effects and immersive interfaces. By executing custom fragment and vertex shaders on the GPU, developers can build organic backgrounds and 3D experiences that maintain performance while degrading gracefully across devices. Three.js abstracts low-level WebGL complexity into a flexible JavaScript API, making advanced shading techniques and real-time 3D rendering accessible for modern web applications.

recent_posts.title: Free Access to JavaScript Training
recent_posts.summary: Certificates.dev is offering free 48-hour access to their JavaScript Mid-Level Developer Certification training program on February 7-8. The program includes 18 coding challenges, 42 quizzes, 17 lessons covering core and advanced JavaScript concepts, and a full trial exam with coding tasks. The platform is created by the same team behind Official Vue.js and Nuxt certifications.

recent_posts.title: Skip the Boilerplate: Build Vue 3 SaaS Apps with Ready-Made Clerk Authentication
recent_posts.summary: A Vue 3 SaaS starter template that integrates Clerk authentication with Shadcn-Vue components, offering a complete dashboard layout with protected routes, dark mode support, and TypeScript. Built with Vite and Vue's Composition API, it provides custom-styled authentication flows, responsive navigation, and a production-ready structure for building SaaS applications quickly.

recent_posts.title: Vue School's Free Weekend
recent_posts.summary: Vue School is offering free access to their entire course library for 48 hours on November 8-9. The collection includes over 80 courses covering Vue.js fundamentals, Nuxt, TypeScript, Tailwind, Pinia, Vue Router, and practical topics like authentication, shader effects, and file uploads. Learners can study at their own pace and access source code for hands-on practice.

recent_posts.title: Shad cn vue Like Nuxt/Vue Librarys  :fire:
recent_posts.summary: A curated list of Vue and Nuxt UI component libraries including Vue Bits for animated components, Inspira UI for reusable designs, shadcn-vue, UI Thing for copy-paste components, Stunning UI with Tailwind CSS integration, LandiNuxt for landing page sections, and Reka UI as the foundational library that many others depend on.

recent_posts.title: Little experiment with nuxt runtime config
recent_posts.summary: Explores common pitfalls with Nuxt 3 runtime configuration and environment variables that work in development but fail in production. Through practical experiments, reveals that empty string initialization causes variables to disappear in production builds, while using process.env directly creates static snapshots that work reliably across environments. Provides a recommended pattern for consistent runtime config behavior.

recent_posts.title: What components are you missing?
recent_posts.summary: A community discussion post asking Vue.js developers to share what UI components they're missing from popular libraries like Vuetify and PrimeVue. The author encourages developers to discuss components they had to build from scratch and invites the community to share hidden gems or alternative solutions they've discovered.

recent_posts.title: Releasing Awesome Nuxt
recent_posts.summary: Awesome Nuxt is a new community-driven platform featuring 80+ hand-picked, high-quality Nuxt projects including templates, starters, and production applications. The platform helps developers find inspiration, learn from real-world implementations, and discover solid starter kits for new projects. Each entry includes GitHub stars, last-updated information, and easy exploration options, with community contributions welcomed.

recent_posts.title: Vue.js Free Weekend From Certificates.dev
recent_posts.summary: Certificates.dev is offering a free 48-hour Vue.js certification training weekend on August 23-24. The program includes training modules on Composition API, Vue Router, and Pinia, along with interactive quizzes, coding challenges, and a trial exam. The certification has been reviewed by Evan You and Vue Core Team members, making it valuable for developers looking to validate their Vue.js skills or identify knowledge gaps.
